description: DocuDevs is a document processing API that extracts structured data from documents with OCR and JSON schemas, supports templates, batch and map-reduce processing, cases with knowledge search and contract analysis, and ships Python and Java SDKs and a CLI.
rules: The REST API base URL is https://api.docudevs.ai
Send the API key in the Authorization header as the bare key, without a Bearer prefix.
Install the Python SDK and CLI with pip install docu-devs-api-client.
In Python, use DocuDevsClient from docudevs.docudevs_client with token=<API key> and await its async methods inside asyncio.run(main()).
Document processing is asynchronous: submit the document, wait until the job finishes, then read the result.
In Python, wait_until_ready(job_guid) waits for a submitted job; check status_code on responses because the client does not always raise on HTTP errors.
Describe extraction schemas with Pydantic models and convert them with json_schema(Model) from docudevs, passed as schema.
In cURL examples poll GET /job/status/{guid} until status is COMPLETED; ERROR, FAILED and TIMEOUT mean the job failed.
The CLI command is docudevs, for example docudevs --help lists the commands.
The Java SDK is ai.docudevs:docudevs-java-sdk; build the client with ai.docudevs.client.DocuDevsClient and its builder.
